privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seo_description: Learn how DigiPulse collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how DigiPulse collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website monitoring service.
privacy.age_notice: DigiPulse is not directed at persons under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy.controller_desc: The data controller is Yurii Mokryi, sole proprietorship in Poland, ul. Piotra Skargi 33b lok. 2, 62-060 Stęszew. DigiPulse: digipulse.cloud. Privacy contact: privacy{'@'}digipulse.cloud.
privacy.what_we_collect_desc: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.personal_info: Personal Information: Email address, name, username provided during registration.
privacy.site_data: Site Data: URLs and names of websites you monitor.
privacy.monitoring_data: Monitoring Data: Response times, uptime statistics, and status history.
privacy.technical_info: Technical Information: IP addresses, browser type, and usage data.
privacy.telegram_data: Telegram Integration Data: Telegram user ID and display name, only if you choose to connect Telegram for monitoring notifications.
privacy.how_we_use_desc: We use your information to (the applicable legal basis under GDPR Art. 6 is indicated for each purpose):
privacy.provide_service: Provide and maintain our monitoring service — legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).
privacy.send_notifications: Send alerts and notifications about your monitored sites, including via Telegram if connected — legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Telegram user ID and display name are processed solely for this notification purpose.
privacy.improve_service: Improve our service and develop new features — legal basis: legitimate interests in improving service quality and developing new features for our users (Art. 6(1)(f)); you may object at any time (see Your Rights below).
privacy.comply_laws: Comply with legal obligations — legal basis: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
privacy.cookies_desc: Our public website (digipulse.cloud) uses cookies and similar technologies. We do not use cookies for advertising or personalized ads.
privacy.cookies_necessary: Necessary: authentication session, Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection on forms), language preference, and local storage of your cookie choice (cookie_consent_v2). IP addresses are also processed by our hosting infrastructure and Cloudflare as strictly necessary to deliver the service (legal basis: legitimate interests, Art. 6(1)(f); retained in server logs for up to 30 days). No consent required for any of the above.
privacy.cookies_analytics: Analytics: Google Analytics (Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC), only with your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). Measures use of public pages (views, device type, approximate location). Does not apply to monitoring data inside your account.
privacy.cookies_legal_basis: We do not use analytics or advertising cookies without your opt-in via the cookie banner.
privacy.cookies_no_ads: No advertising: we do not run Google Ads. ad_storage, ad_user_data, and ad_personalization stay denied in our Google tag.
privacy.cookies_retention: Analytics data in Google Analytics is retained according to our GA4 property settings (typically up to 14 months). Your cookie choice is stored locally until you clear it or change it in Cookie settings in the footer.
privacy.cookies_transfers: Google may process data outside the EEA/UK. Google relies on appropriate safeguards (e.g. EU Standard Contractual Clauses). See Google’s privacy policy and Analytics data processing terms.
privacy.cookies_consent: Until you choose in the banner, analytics is off (Google Consent Mode v2). You can allow analytics, reject non-essential cookies, or toggle analytics in Settings.
privacy.cookies_change: Change your choice anytime via Cookie settings in the site footer, or clear site data in your browser.
privacy.cookies_complaint: You may lodge a complaint with a data protection authority in your country. As the controller is established in Poland, the competent authority is: UODO — Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, uodo.gov.pl.
privacy.sharing_desc: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your information only in the following cases:
privacy.service_providers: With trusted service providers acting as data processors: Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC (Google Analytics — only when you consent); Cloudflare, Inc. (DDoS protection and Turnstile bot filtering — processes IP addresses; covered by Standard Contractual Clauses); Hetzner Online GmbH (server infrastructure, data centres in the EU — Finland and Germany). We do not sell your data to any third party.
privacy.legal_requirements: When required by applicable law, court order, or government authority; or to establish, exercise, or defend against legal claims, prevent fraud, or enforce our Terms of Service.
privacy.retention_desc: Account data (name, email, username): retained for the duration of your account and deleted within 30 days of account closure. Monitoring data (response times, history): retained for 90 days on a rolling basis. Support communications: retained for 2 years. Billing records: retained for 5 years in accordance with Polish accounting law. Server and access logs (including IP addresses): retained for up to 30 days. You may request earlier deletion at any time.
privacy.security_desc: We implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures — including encryption of data in transit (HTTPS/TLS), access controls, and regular security reviews — to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.breach_desc: In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the competent supervisory authority (UODO) within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, as required by GDPR Art. 33. Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights, we will also notify you directly without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34).
privacy.access_data: Access the personal information we hold about you.
privacy.delete_data: Request deletion of your personal information.
privacy.data_portability: Receive a copy of your data in a portable format.
privacy.opt_out: Opt out of optional product emails, if we send them (separate from website cookies).
privacy.withdraw_cookies: Withdraw or change consent to analytics cookies at any time via Cookie settings in the site footer.
privacy.restrict_processing: Request restriction of processing of your data (e.g. while accuracy is disputed or an objection is pending) — Art. 18 GDPR.
privacy.object_processing: Object to processing based on legitimate interests, including profiling — Art. 21 GDPR.
privacy.no_automated: Not be subject to solely automated decision-making that produces significant legal effects — Art. 22 GDPR. We do not carry out such processing.
privacy.complaint: Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority if you believe we process your data unlawfully. As the controller is established in Poland, the competent supervisory authority is: UODO — Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, uodo.gov.pl.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: privacy{'@'}digipulse.cloud

b2b.seo_desc: Protect your ad budget from site outages. DigiPulse checks your site every minute and alerts you in Telegram. Up to 6 sites free forever.
b2b.badge: MONITORING 24/7 · NO CODE · UP TO 6 SITES FREE
b2b.hero_desc: DigiPulse checks your site {bold} and sends an instant Telegram alert if it goes down, your SSL is expiring, or your domain is about to get blocked.
b2b.hero_trust: ⚡ Setup takes {bold}. No code changes. No plugins required.
b2b.pain_step_4: Customer sees the error and leaves
b2b.pain_card1_desc: Instagram ads drive traffic — and the site throws a 500 error. You pay per click, the customer goes to a competitor. Google registers bounces and drops your rankings. And you don't even know it's happening.
b2b.pain_card2_desc: The browser shows 'Insecure connection' — and 95% of visitors close the tab immediately. SSL expires quietly, without warning. Same with domains — one missed email and your site is gone.
b2b.how_title: Three steps — and your site is protected
b2b.how_step1_desc: Just paste the URL — no code, no plugins. We'll set up all checks automatically: availability, SSL, response time.
b2b.how_step2_desc: Click 'Connect Telegram', send /start to the bot — and you're done. Alerts come to you personally or to a team chat.
b2b.how_step3_desc: If something goes wrong — you'll know in 5 seconds, not a day later from an unhappy customer.
b2b.offer_desc: We don't limit you to a trial period. Add up to 6 sites and use full monitoring for free — no credit card, no auto-charges.
b2b.offer_point_2: Check every minute — 1,440 times a day
b2b.offer_point_4: SSL & domain monitoring with 30/14/7 day warnings
b2b.offer_note: No credit card. More than 6 sites — paid plans available.
b2b.agency_desc: No more waiting for the client to notice their site is down and call you at 11pm. You know first. And you show up with a solution before they even open their email.
b2b.agency_point_1: Add 7 to 60 client sites to one dashboard
b2b.agency_point_2: Real-time status for every site — no switching tabs
b2b.agency_point_3: Automated reports for clients: uptime, incidents, SSL
b2b.agency_point_4: You get alerted before the client — and come with a solution
b2b.agency_note: * To create a request for an extended package, you need to create a free account.
b2b.faq_q1: Do I need to install plugins or change site code?
b2b.faq_a1: No. Monitoring is entirely external — we check your site the same way regular visitors do. Nothing to install, nothing to connect inside the site. Your server is not affected.
b2b.faq_q2: What if Telegram goes down and I don't get an alert?
b2b.faq_a2: Telegram is the primary channel, but not the only one. We also send an email as a backup. The incident is also saved in the dashboard — you'll see it next time you log in.
b2b.faq_q3: How much does it cost for more than 6 sites?
b2b.faq_a3: Paid plans start from $5/month. For agencies — from $19/month for a package of 7 to 60 sites. No hidden fees, no auto-charges without notice.
b2b.faq_q4: I use Shopify / Prom / Tilda — does this work?
b2b.faq_a4: Yes. We don't care what platform your site runs on — we check the URL, not the platform. Shopify, WordPress, Prom, Tilda, Webflow, custom server — all the same.
b2b.faq_q5: How quickly will I know my site is down?
b2b.faq_a5: Checks run every minute. Once an issue is detected, the alert arrives within seconds. In practice, from outage to Telegram message — under a minute on average.
b2b.final_desc: Connect up to 6 sites for free in 2 minutes. Status, SSL, response time, availability — all in one dashboard.
